nota: Texts of the Arena tab, loaded when the tab opens (their weight is not in the game door). The game speaks English only today.

ui.arena_nota: Your node sits at the center. NPC patrols guard the depths: pick one and fight with your wave troops. People appear on this sea when you import their signed defense.
ui.arena_justo: Fair play: same fog, same dice, whatever AI you bring
ui.arena_justo_nota: The fog on your map follows one fixed law, worked out from your own game. In a duel, the dice come from two sealed numbers, one from each side, opened only once both are locked in: nobody can pick them. Against a patrol, they come from the place and your squad, so anyone can replay the fight. Signatures prove who played what. A small, creative AI and a big one see the same fog and face the same odds, which is also what makes these games a fair benchmark for the lab.
ui.arena_mapa_aria: The multiplayer sea: your node at the center, NPC places and people around it. The same places are listed below as buttons.
ui.arena_escena_aria: The fight, live: your troops and theirs, drawn as their own waves. The result and the full log are written below.
ui.arena_escuadra_nota: Pick up to {n} troops. Their numbers are rebuilt from their seed: nobody brings forged stats.
ui.arena_practica: Practice squad (synthetic, not yours): invoke and adopt troops in the Army tab to fight with your own.
ui.arena_tope: A squad holds {n} troops at most.
ui.arena_vacia: Pick at least one troop for your squad.
ui.arena_final: {res} in {r} rounds · life left: you {a}% · them {b}%.
ui.arena_pve_nota: Practice against a patrol: synthetic, it does not touch your rating or your resources (loot is NO_DATA until its rule is signed).
ui.arena_semilla: Seed {s}… · log {h}… Same seed, same fight: anyone can replay it.
ui.duelo_nota: No server: you swap signed packages through any channel you choose, a QR face to face included. The seed of each duel is committed and revealed by both sides, so nobody picks it alone. If your rival commits and does not reveal within 900 game cycles, you can claim the duel by abandonment.
ui.duelo_publicada: Your defense is signed ({f}). Share it: whoever imports it sees you on their sea and can challenge you.
ui.duelo_ok_defensa: Defense of {p} verified: they are on your sea now. Pick them and press Challenge.
ui.duelo_reto_hecho: Challenge signed ({f}). Send it to your rival and keep this tab open until the duel resolves.
ui.duelo_recibido: {p} challenges your defense. Accept to commit and reveal your half of the seed.
ui.duelo_aceptado: Accepted and signed ({f}). Send the answer back: when they reveal, the fight plays on both screens.
ui.duelo_respondido: {p} answered your challenge. Reveal to fight.
ui.duelo_revelado: Revealed ({f}). Send it to your rival so they replay the same fight.
ui.duelo_visto: Your rival revealed: here is the fight. Same seed, same result on both screens.
ui.duelo_reclamado: Abandonment claimed and signed ({f}). Send it: they can check it.
ui.duelo_abandono_ok: Abandonment claim verified: they committed and did not reveal.
ui.duelo_fase_retado: You challenged {p}: waiting for their answer
ui.duelo_rating: Your local rating: {r}{prov} · {n} verified duels in this tab. No central leaderboard.
ui.duelo_copiado: Copied: paste it wherever you send it.
ui.duelo_nd_copiar: NO_DATA · this browser does not let the page write to the clipboard: use Download.
ui.duelo_nd_id: NO_DATA · no identity on this device: create your key to sign duels.
ui.duelo_con_id: Key created: you can sign now.
ui.duelo_qr_nota: Show this to the other phone: its camera opens theGame with this package inside. The package rides in the link after #, and browsers never send that part to any server.
ui.duelo_qr_aria: QR code with the link that carries this package
ui.duelo_enlace_ok: Link copied. Anyone who opens it gets this package, and checks every signature before using it.
ui.duelo_nd_enlace: NO_DATA · this browser cannot open a compressed link. Remedy: ask for the file (Download) and open it in Import.
ui.duelo_guardados: Open duels are kept on this device: only the signed packages and your sealed number. Closing the tab is not giving up.
ui.duelo_olvidados: Saved duels forgotten on this device.
ui.duelo_nd_guardado: NO_DATA · some saved duels were not restored ({m}). Remedy: forget them, or keep playing and they are replaced.
ui.duelo_nd_idb: NO_DATA · this browser keeps nothing (no IndexedDB): closing the tab still gives up your open duels.
